description: The ANCFCC, Morocco's national agency for land registration, cadastre and mapping, sells the country's official cartographic and geodetic products. The products page read on 2026-09-28 lists base topographic maps in analogue and digital form at 1:25,000, 1:50,000, 1:100,000 and 1:250,000 with the underlying restitution data; general and relief maps of Morocco; thematic maps such as regional maps of the 12 regions, the administrative map, the road map and tourist maps; national and regional atlases; city plans at 1:5,000 to 1:10,000; aerial photographs by zone, date, scale and resolution; orthophotos; geodetic data including point coordinates, levelling benchmarks and permanent GPS station data; and a digital terrain model, with a product catalogue and sales points in Rabat and six regional offices. Coverage is national. Access is by purchase; prices and licence conditions were not read. Caveats: products are not downloadable online, and dates vary by sheet. It supports base mapping, terrain and road network context for hazard exposure studies in Morocco. Related record: data-ancfcc-morocco-permanent-gnss-network covers the agency's GNSS stations.
